text:
Sec-Gemini

Sec-Gemini is an experimental cybersecurity-focused agent by Google. It is currently in an invite-only trusted-tester phase.

 Notebooks

 Notebook Description Colab 
 --- --- --- 
 basic sdk usage.ipynb Connect, create sessions, send prompts, stream responses, and upload files 
 sdk byot custom mcp.ipynb Combine baseline local tools and a custom FastMCP server via Bring-Your-Own-Tools (BYOT) 
 skills usage.ipynb Create, upload, and apply custom skills in sessions 
 dfir investigation.ipynb Run digital forensics and log analysis workflows with the SDK and BYOT 

 SDK & Documentation

 Documentation: 
 Python SDK & TUI: sec-gemini on PyPI ( pip install sec-gemini )
